title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Late Show) on 1970-02-13
source: 2-source matrix mix of shnid #97639(SBD) and shnid #123814(AUD)

ai_review.summary: Pristine matrix recording captures a transcendent Dark Star > Other One > Lovelight sequence with excellent sound and unforgettable vibe.
ai_review.review: The late‑show tape is praised for its crystal‑clear matrix mix that even outshines many archival copies, delivering the soaring Dark Star into The Other One and Lovelight with vivid detail. Listeners rave about the emotional impact of the performance – from Jerry’s prime‑time guitar tone to the acoustic Bear’s Choice numbers – making it a must‑hear despite one reviewer calling it overrated.

ai_rating.rationale: Five of six reviews are 5‑star, highlighting both stellar musical moments and high‑quality sound; the lone 4‑star comment is only mildly critical, yielding an overall rating near the top of the scale.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the mix 'pristine', 'great sound' and note a slight brightness that some users soften with bass/reverb, but overall the recording is crisp, well‑balanced, and far superior to straight audience copies.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show builds a powerful arc centered on the Dark Star > Other One > Lovelight suite, punctuated by gentle acoustic Bear’s Choice material and rounded out with a complete Uncle John's Band, delivering a cohesive and emotionally resonant performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Several reviewers cite Jerry Garcia in his prime, noting perfect tone and the way his playing drives the Dark Star sequence.
